summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K to disclose open-market share repurchases executed on July 27, 2026. The company bought back 75,000 Series A shares at MXN$1,183.44 each, totaling ~MXN$88.8M, under an authorization from the April 28, 2026 shareholder meeting. Following the buyback, 111,317,402 shares remained outstanding, with 984,351 held in treasury. Citi Mexico served as broker. This is an ordinary-course capital return program, not a tender offer or going-private transaction. Watch for continued execution under the standing authorization and potential impact on share count and EPS.
